name: io.github.hermoso-ai/hermoso
title: Hermoso
description: Marketing on autopilot from your own agent. 841 tools, all usable alone. Publishing, scheduling and ad campaign management cost no credits.

packageArguments.description: Run the Hermoso stdio MCP server

environmentVariables.name: HERMOSO_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Hermoso agent key (hmk_…) from app.hermoso.ai → Settings → Agents & API. Required against the hosted app.

environmentVariables.name: HERMOSO_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Hermoso API origin. Defaults to https://app.hermoso.ai; set http://localhost:3000 to run against your own server.
